event_station_007@node_branch_1_beta_0.quirk: They address you, briefly, by what appears to be your hull registration number.

event_station_013@node_branch_1_beta_0.quirk: You elect not to think about it too hard.

event_station_013@node_branch_1_beta_1.quirk: Their head tilts with slow precision, like a dial being set.

shipLog.text: ◆ ARIA is thrilled the crop has been planted! She has already named all the seedlings! The ship computer has asked her to stop!
Arrived at TRAPPIST-4 (Not The Good One)! The leg cost −5 FUEL, −4 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 6 DAYS. Lovely view!
◆ Soil sampler survey logged (1/3). The colony office will want this.
Departure Protocol: we chose “Check the crop one last time before departure”. Love that for us!
The crop is fine. +2 MORALE, 1 DAY. A win, statistically!
◆ A planet! ARIA has picked out a spot for a picnic! The spot is in a hurricane! The hurricane is very pretty from up here!
Arrived at Asteroid Field 2! The leg cost −5 FUEL, −4 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 6 DAYS. Lovely view!
◆ The ship computer has started calling the wheat "humanity's oldest crewmate." Ten thousand years of harvests, and it sounds almost fond.
Spots on the Leaves: we chose “The botanist checks every plant”. Love that for us!
Dr. +1 CROP, 2 DAYS. A win, statistically!
◆ Asteroid field! Every one of these rocks has waited millions of years to meet us! ARIA would like to keep it a long-distance friendship!
Arrived at Route Decision! The leg cost −5 FUEL, −4 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 6 DAYS. Lovely view!
Right of Way: we chose “Starboard lane — the port beacon has a shifty look”. Love that for us!
You go starboard. 1 DAY. A win, statistically!
◆ Still thinking about launch day! Every system was perfect and the paperwork was barely any paperwork at all!
The Wheat hit VEGETATIVE! 26% grown, health 100. Thriving!
Arrived at Midpoint Station (Temporarily Named)! The leg cost −5 FUEL, −4 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 6 DAYS. Lovely view!
◆ Every stalk in the bay is the same wheat, near enough. One bad spore would find all of them at once. The crew tries not to think about it.
Walk-In Clinic: we chose “Pay for full treatment — 12 gold”. Love that for us!
Treatment, adjustments, one minor procedure conducted to the… +5 MORALE, −12 GOLD, 2 DAYS. A win, statistically!
Market Row: we chose “BACK TO DOCK”. Love that for us!
−1 FOOD, 1 DAY. Still a win!
Station Inbound: we chose “LEAVE STATION”. Love that for us!
Nothing aboard changed. A win, statistically!
◆ The station captain pings the comms once on your way out: “Safe burns out there, captain. The ring'll still be here next pass.”
◆ Passing the window: a bumper sticker floating free: "MY OTHER SHIP IS ALSO A REGRETTABLE DECISION".
Arrived at Depot Kowalski! The leg cost −5 FUEL, −4 FOOD, −2 H2O, −1 O2, 6 DAYS. Lovely view!
◆ MARV files a note on what looking back at everything from far away does to crews. The effect has a name.
The Middle: we chose “Mark it — small ceremony, real juice”. Love that for us!
The crew assembles at the viewport for the equator crossing. +5 MORALE, 1 DAY. A win, statistically!
Market Row: we chose “BACK TO DOCK”. Love that for us!
−1 FOOD, 1 DAY. Still a win!
Station Inbound: we chose “LEAVE STATION”. Love that for us!
Nothing aboard changed. A win, statistically!
◆ The station captain pings the comms once on your way out: “Safe burns out there, captain. The ring'll still be here next pass.”
◆ Docking at the station! ARIA has prepared a warm greeting for the dockmaster! The dockmaster has prepared an invoice! Everyone is ready!
◆ GROWBAY ALERT — pest outbreak detected. TREAT from the growbay before it compounds.

fee.detail: You're breathing their air on approach. Itemized.
